root_text:
Gibbs runs swift as Vikings' pride,
Dan Campbell leads, no fears to hide.
Goff once a Ram, now shines anew,
Joy Taylor’s voice, her wisdom true.
Zendaya, Moore, stars that inspire,
Rise like Trudeau, dreams afire. #HMPV https://t.co/qW5kl86
